chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar and Sa'd ibn Abdullah both narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from Muhammad ibn al-Khalid al-Barqi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ziyad ibn al-Munthir Abi al-Jarud, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

I was granted five things which no one before me was granted: the Earth was made for me a place of prayer and pure, I was assisted by awe (being placed in the hearts of enemies), lawful spoils of war were made for me, I was given the essence of speech, and I was granted intercession.

key_terms.الطُّور: Ritual purity (often read as طهور in this context, meaning purity/cleansing)
key_terms.النُّصْرَةُ بِالرُّعْب: Victory through awe/terror placed in enemies' hearts
key_terms.الْأَرْضُ مَسْجَدًا: The earth as a place of prayer

ai.seo_question: What are the five unique gifts granted to Prophet Muhammad that were not given to previous prophets?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal*, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s unique status through five distinct privileges, emphasizing the universality of his mission via the earth as a portable place of prayer and the efficacy of his concise, comprehensive speech (*jawami' al-kalim*). These gifts not only distinguish him from previous prophets but also establish practical legal precedents for the Muslim community, such as the permissibility of war booty and the eschatological power of intercession (*shafa'ah*).

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-57 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar and Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqy, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqy, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sin’an, on the authority of Zyad ibn al-Monzar Abil-Jarud, on the authority of Sa’id ibn Jabeer, on the authority of Ibn Ab’bas that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“I have been granted five things which had not been granted to anyone before me: all the Earth has been established as a mosque and all its dirt has been declared to be pure. I have been assisted by being awesome. War booties have become lawful for me. I have been given the most complete sayings. I have also been granted the right to intercede.”
